prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1473; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with acute pain and restricted range of motion in the right shoulder. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the crash, and the presenting complaints fit that mechanism well. Imaging and clinical examination findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury. No prior injury to the same body region is known from the history obtained. Care was delivered across 25 visits, consisting of physical therapy, graded range-of-motion exercises, and pain management. Treatment ran somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, and progress was gradual but steady. Billing records show two similar charges on the same day, which are currently being reviewed for accuracy. Patient has been advised on a home exercise program and will be reassessed at discharge to determine residual limitation and need for further care.
